show_slice(intensity: numpy.ndarray, mask: numpy.ndarray | None, *, title: str, waveforms: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None) → None¶

Render intensity as grayscale, overlay mask in translucent red if given, and draw any waveforms underneath.

_draw_waveforms(waveforms: list[dict[str, Any]] | None) → None¶

Plot each flow waveform in waveforms on the waveform axes, color-coding by offset from the selected cross-section (blue = selected, red = upstream, green = downstream).

Each curve’s cardiac time-averaged flow magnitude (mean_flow_ml_min) is appended to its legend entry, and the selected station’s value is called out in a box beside the curves — mL/min is the reporting unit, while the curves stay in the ml/s the pipeline computes.
